en: O enemy, the Kurdish-speaking people still remains,
the one who fires the cannon of time will not break it [?].
Let no one say the Kurds are dead; the Kurds are alive,
alive; our flag will never be lowered.
The Kurdish youth have risen to their feet like heroes,
to paint with blood the crown of life.
Let no one say the Kurds are dead; the Kurds are alive,
alive; our flag will never be lowered.
We are the children of the Medes and of Kay Khosrow,
our faith, our religion is the homeland alone.
Let no one say the Kurds are dead; the Kurds are alive,
alive; our flag will never be lowered.
We are the children of the red colour and of revolution,
look, how bloody our past is.
Let no one say the Kurds are dead; the Kurds are alive,
alive; our flag will never be lowered.
The Kurdish youth are always ready and prepared,
ready to give their lives, to give their lives, always to give their lives.
Let no one say the Kurds are dead; the Kurds are alive,
alive; our flag will never be lowered.
rom: Ey reqîb, her mawe qewmî kurdziman,
Nayşikênê danerî topî zeman.
Kes nełê kurd mirdûwe, kurd zîndûwe,
Zîndûwe, qet nanewê ałakeman.
Lawî kurd hestaye ser pê wek dilêr,
Ta be xwên nexşî bika tacî jiyan.
Kes nełê kurd mirdûwe, kurd zîndûwe,
Zîndûwe, qet nanewê ałakeman.
Ême řołey Mîdya w Keyxusrewîn,
Dînman, ayînman, her nîştiman
Kes nełê kurd mirdûwe, kurd zîndûwe,
Zîndwe, qet nanewê ałakeman.
Ême řołey řengî sûr û şořişîn,
Seyrî ke, xwênawîye řabirdûman.
Kes nełê kurd mirdûwe, kurd zîndûwe,
Zîndûwe, qet nanewê ałakeman.
Lawî kurd her hazir û amadeye,
Gyanfîdaye, gyanfîda, her gyanfîda.
Kes nełê kurd mirdûwe, kurd zîndûwe,
Zîndûwe, qet nanewê ałakeman.
notes: Romanization: the Kurdish Latin (Hawar) alphabet, with ł and ř for the Sorani letters ڵ and ڕ, as Sorani writers in the Latin alphabet add them; line 3.4 keeps the text's shorter spelling زیندوە (zîndwe).
line 1.1: 'her mawe', 'still remains'; 'qewmî kurdziman', 'the people of the Kurdish tongue'.

line 1.2: 'danerî topî zeman' is read as 'the one who fires (sets) the cannon of time', i.e. the blows of time or fortune; 'daner' is literally 'the one who places or sets', and other readings ('the makers of the weapons of the age') are given.
line 1.4: 'nanewê', 'does not bow, is not lowered'.
line 2.2: 'nexşî bika', 'adorn, paint, inscribe': to inscribe the crown of life in blood.
line 3.1: Kay Khosrow (Keyxusrew), the legendary Iranian king of the Shahnameh, sometimes identified with the Median king Cyaxares.
line 5.2: 'gyanfîda', one who gives his life as a sacrifice.
